text:
incidentbot: ALERT: failed to deliver pages for service `transformer-ingest` via PagerRelay -> notify-proxy returned 502. auto-escalation suppressed. incident id INC-20260316-71

sanjay: seeing this too, PagerRelay -> notify-proxy 502s across multiple regions. any recent deploys?

maya: not from transformer team, last deploy ~2h ago. quick grep shows upstream returned `timeout` at 10:12:33 UTC.

ops-lead: @oncall-uk tagging you for manual handoff — do not rely on auto paging for now :warning:

oncall-uk: got the page, starting live triage. pulling notify-bridge and proxy logs now, ETA 15m.

nicole: quick curl from my laptop: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -v https://notify.internal/pagerhook` -> returns `502` and body "Bad Gateway". snippet from proxy log: ```2026-03-16T10:12:33Z notify-proxy error upstream timeout id=abc123 backend=pager-relay```.

deploy-bot: rolling restart triggered: notify-bridge v2.14.3 -> restarting 3/3 replicas (health checks enabled).

sanjay: I pushed a temporary routing rule to direct 1% of pager traffic to `pager-relay-fallback` (header X-RR: fallback). verifying now.

ops-lead: good, do manual pages to fallback while we confirm delivery. Sanjay can you increase to 5% if fallback looks healthy?

sanjay: applied -> routing rule updated. curl test to fallback returns `200` and body "ok".

oncall-uk: receiving manual pages from fallback, looks good :thumbsup: — no customer pages lost so far.

maya: timeline note: spike in notify-bridge queue depth at 10:11 UTC correlated with a large telemetry flush from batch-worker. investigating rate-limiter interactions.

nicole: creating the incident ticket INC-20260316-71 with logs and timeline. Adding playbook link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/pager-integration

incidentbot: NOTE: automated page suppression was triggered after 3 consecutive 502s from notify-proxy; suppression remains in effect until health-check passes.

ops-lead: plan: 1) monitor for 30m; 2) if backlog drains and health checks green, revert routing and re-enable auto-escalation; 3) if errors persist, flip full traffic to fallback and declare SEV.

oncall-uk: backlog is draining, receiving confirmations from fallback, no customer impact observed. keeping watch, will update in 20m.

maya: follow-ups (postmortem actions): add alert on notify-proxy 502 rate > 1% sustained for 5m, add soft retries in notify-bridge, and throttle batch-worker flushes during peak.

nicole: added action items to INC-20260316-71 and assigned owners.

ops-lead: thanks everyone. keep this thread for live updates, we'll convert to retro after stable.

oncall-uk: closing handoff, staying on watch for 30m then clear. :white_check_mark:
